summary: Quince Therapeutics filed an 8-K announcing a special stockholder meeting to approve the issuance of common stock upon conversion of Series C Convertible Preferred Stock and related warrants/options, which may exceed 20% and could result in change of control under Nasdaq rules. The filing includes unaudited pro forma financials as of June 30, 2026. No deal terms, pricing, or premium are provided. This is a routine corporate governance and disclosure matter, not a special situation such as an acquisition or restructuring.
